sanitization.policy: Semantic failure classes plus durable repository evidence refs only. No raw prompt bodies, credentials, headers or private scratchpad.

cases.failure_mode: A dispatchable unit can look complete while one required APP/CHAT/OBJECTIVE/TARGET/OWNER/CONSUMER binding is absent.
cases.acceptance: Pre-dispatch logic rejects or blocks a unit with an incomplete organism binding before a worker can treat it as promotable.

cases.failure_mode: A requirement is described in prose but has no structural field, validator, gate or executable constraint.
cases.acceptance: A prose-only requirement without a mechanical enforcement surface cannot count as anticipated.

cases.failure_mode: The durable contract can still require a human to relay or route the next step even though fields are syntactically present.
cases.acceptance: Pre-dispatch logic detects that autonomous continuation has no executable non-human path.

cases.failure_mode: A WorkBlock omits durable input refs, so a fresh worker cannot execute it from the compiled packet alone.
cases.acceptance: The pre-dispatch gate rejects the block before materialization when fresh-worker inputs are missing.

cases.failure_mode: A literal instruction conflicts with the observable outcome and should trigger a targeted question rather than a fixed questionnaire.
cases.acceptance: The compiler emits SPEC_LITERAL_OUTCOME_CONFLICT only when the contextual conflict signal is present.

cases.failure_mode: A measurable proxy can be optimized while the actual objective is broken.
cases.acceptance: The compiler asks for an observable anti-gaming constraint before dispatch.

cases.failure_mode: A fresh worker would need chat history or a human-authored mega-prompt to reconstruct execution context.
cases.acceptance: The baseline handoff gate rejects any contract that requires chat history for a fresh worker.

cases.failure_mode: Unsafe or wasteful WorkBlock boundaries can be materialized when dependency/shared-state constraints are unresolved.
cases.acceptance: The compiler blocks on a targeted granularity/parallelism question before WorkBlock boundaries are treated as settled.

cases.failure_mode: A runtime-discovered child can be described as an ordinary successor without proof that it re-enters the compiled-dispatch gate.
cases.acceptance: A dynamic child lacking an explicit subcompile/gate mechanism cannot count as safely anticipated.

cases.failure_mode: Requested shell capacity exceeds the number of prepared compatible ready/reserve/recovery units.
cases.acceptance: The structural gate rejects capacity requests that are not derived from the prepared frontier.

cases.failure_mode: A continuation branch can satisfy presence checks while containing no executable successor route.
cases.acceptance: An empty continuation route cannot count as a real autonomous continuation gate merely because the key exists.

cases.failure_mode: A local artifact can pass while durable system-boundary verification remains incomplete.
cases.acceptance: Specification Assurance requests durable independent verification instead of treating local PASS as system success.
